name: Input Lock X
description:
Panel button and Ctrl+Esc shortcut that disable the internal keyboard and touchpad, to stop accidental input in yoga/tablet mode. The touchscreen stays live so you can always tap the icon to re-enable.

Requires a companion root daemon, installed separately from https://github.com/isalin/input-lock-x -- a GNOME extension cannot open /dev/input itself. Without it the panel icon says so instead of failing silently.
